description.value: A mossy, tree-sheltered village campground at the south end of Sunset Park beside the Yakoun River Estuary on Haida Gwaii; four tent sites with potable water and outhouses, no showers, first come first served.

address.value: 36 Cedar Avenue West, Port Clements, BC V0T 1R0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Village of Port Clements website provides detailed first-party content about Sunset Park Campground: 10 sites (6 RV with electrical hookups, 4 tent), potable water at taps, a public gazebo, outhouses, and explicit statements that there are no showers, no laundry, and no wifi. The campground reservation subpage (dated 2025-04-07) explicitly states no reservation system exists and the campground is first come, first served, which contradicts a statement on the main campground page implying online reservations are available—the reservation subpage is treated as more authoritative. OSM tags (tents=yes, caravans=yes, fee=yes) are consistent with website content.
concerns: Address listed (36 Cedar Avenue West) is the Village Office mailing address, not the physical campground location; the website describes the campground as being at the south end of Sunset Park near the Yakoun River Estuary.

Contradiction between the main campground page (implies online reservations are available) and the campground reservation subpage (explicitly states no reservation system, first come first served); the reservation subpage dated 2025-04-07 is treated as authoritative.
OSM record contains no phone number or address; both values sourced from website only and cannot be confirmed against OSM.
Minor address inconsistency within the website itself: footer on most pages shows '36 Cedar Avenue' while the contact page shows '36 Cedar Avenue West.'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, year-round municipal campground in the remote Haida Gwaii community of Port Clements; one of very few accommodation options in this area, making it a high-value listing for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: No wifi or internet in the campground; website notes internet is available at the Vancouver Island Regional Library branch in Port Clements. Electrical hookups are present on RV sites only; no electrical access is mentioned for the four tent sites.

wow_evidence: four tent sites with potable water and outhouses, no showers, first come first served
